prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1437; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this office now represents our client in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred while our client was making a left turn and was struck by another vehicle. Our client sustained injuries as a result of the collision and is entitled to full compensation for those injuries and related losses.

Effective immediately, all communication regarding this claim, including requests for statements, scheduling of examinations, and settlement discussions, must be directed to this office rather than to our client. Please do not contact our client directly.

We also request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits of every policy that may apply to the insured driver and vehicle involved in this loss, along with a certified copy of the declarations page for each policy.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or vehicle data, repair records, adjuster notes, and any other materials in your possession or control. Please confirm in writing that these items will be retained.
